player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Chopsticks. On your turn, choose one of:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=your hand (0 or 1), O=opponent hand (0 or 1).
    - Opponent's hand count increases by your hand; if >=5, it becomes 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  to redistribute your total fingers into L and R (L+R = your total).
Reply with exactly one of those commands.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Guoko kwa ũrĩa ũrarũa {opp_idx} nĩ gũkuĩte.
invalid_move.split_sum: Mũigana wa ciĩga icio no mũhaka ũkorũo {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: No mũhaka Split ĩkorũo nĩ yagarũrire ũrĩa moko maku matambĩte kũgayana.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Hatua batili. Tumia “[attack M O]” au “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} anashambulia mkono wa P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: unatoka {opp_val} hadi {new_val}.

outcome.win: Moko ma ũrĩa ũrarũaga naake nĩ marakuĩte.
